The '''''Arrow of Sullust''''' was a [[Bulwark Mark III]] [[Battlecruiser/Legends|battlecruiser]] manufactured by the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] shortly before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]. Given SoroSuub's official position of neutrality during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] despite its sympathies toward the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], the corporation could not openly deliver the newly completed battlecruiser to the Rebellion. Instead, a group of Rebels stole the ''Arrow of Sullust'' in the [[Sullustan Orbital Shipyards]], holding off pursuing [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces with only a skeleton crew.<ref name="SoR">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>
